 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = freq.most_common(2)[1][0]
    # Lattice lines are the rows/columns predominantly carrying the divider.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == divider for v in grid[r]) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h)) > h // 2]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]])
            v = corners[0]
            row.append(v if v != divider and all(x == v for x in corners) else background)
        out.append(row)
    # Remove blank cells beyond the marked lattice's right edge.
    while out and out[0] and all(row[-1] == background for row in out):
        for row in out:
            row.pop()
    return out
"
}
